label: Recurring Compliance Check
intent: Find params.tenantId's tasks due before params.dueBefore and run compliance-check-item for each: fetch evidence, classify it via agent, route to human review when expired and post a reminder when expiring soon.

n-query-due.label: Search tasks due soon
n-query-due.intent: Search params.tenantId's tasks due before params.dueBefore, earliest first, through the public API (auth, validation). The filter names params.tenantId; the API's tenant query filter also pins every read to the caller's tenant, global admin included, so another tenant's tasks are never returned. One page of at most 50 tasks is processed; the cursor is not followed. The search has no tag filter and filters status by equality only, so completed tasks are included.

n-loop-each.label: Process each due task
n-loop-each.intent: Start one compliance-check-item child workflow per searched task, at most 5 at a time; each child has its own context and suspends independently at its human review.

n-summary-event.label: Publish compliance summary
n-summary-event.intent: Emit an aggregate summary event after every child workflow finishes.
